<size=26>Eternal Blade: Enters <color=#ffda58>Blade Will State</color> after performing <color=#ffda58>any 3-Ping twice</color>.\nEternal Blade: Sword Heart stacks no longer decrease during <color=#ffda58>Blade Will State</color>. Casting Leap Skills extends Blade Will State by up to 5s.</size>
BuffDescDetail:
1. Enters Blade Will State after performing <color=#ffda58>any 3-Ping twice</color>.
2. Sword Heart stacks no longer decrease during Blade Will State. Casting Reverse Flash or Sheathing Slash extends Blade Will State by up to 5s.
3. Grants Hypertune Drive and Baseline Calibration. Deployment <color=#ffda58>does not consume Computing Power quota</color>.

<size=22>Arrow Unleashed: <color=#ffda58>While off-field</color>, gains energy arrows whenever the active character performs a 3-Ping. The next Signature's DMG increases based on the number of energy arrows gained.\nArrow Unleashed: <color=#ffda58>Casts the Signature upon switching in</color>, then gains 3 sets of Signal Orbs.</size>
BuffDescDetail:
1. While off-field, each 3-Ping performed by the <color=#ffda58>active character</color> grants 1 energy arrow. Excess energy arrows will increase the next Signature's DMG, up to 3 stacks.
2. <color=#ffda58>Automatically casts the Signature upon switching in</color>, then gains 3 sets of Signal Orbs.
3. Grants Hypertune Drive and Baseline Calibration. Deployment <color=#ffda58>does not consume Computing Power quota</color>.

<size=20>Bladed Riposte: Increases the DMG of the <color=#ffda58>Yellow Orb skill</color>, Counterattack. Tap Basic Attack while charging to trigger its wide-area counterattack manually.\nBladed Riposte: After triggering <color=#ffda58>the Yellow Orb skill's wide-area counterattack</color>, gains 250% ATK and prevents Charge Points from decreasing; this effect lasts 5s.</size>
BuffDescDetail:
1. Increases the DMG of the <color=#ffda58>Yellow Orb skill, Counterattack</color>, by 200%. Tap Basic Attack <color=#ffda58>0.8-1s</color> after casting it to trigger a wide-area counterattack.
2. After the Yellow Orb skill triggers its wide-area counterattack, gains 250% ATK and prevents Charge Points from decreasing; this effect lasts 5s.
3. Grants Hypertune Drive and Baseline Calibration. Deployment <color=#ffda58>does not consume Computing Power quota</color>.

<size=20>Blazing Ember: Increases the pursuit range of the <color=#ffda58>Yellow Orb skill</color>, Covering Barrage, and locks it to Slot 1.\nBlazing Ember: <color=#ffda58>Taking a hit</color> while casting the Yellow Orb skill increases ATK by 140% for 5s.</size>
BuffDescDetail:
1. Doubles the pursuit range of the <color=#ffda58>Yellow Orb skill, Covering Barrage</color>, and locks the skill to Slot 1. Karenina is more likely to receive Yellow Orbs.
2. If <color=#ffda58>hit within 2s</color> after casting Covering Barrage, gains 140% ATK for 5s.
3. Grants Hypertune Drive and Baseline Calibration. Deployment <color=#ffda58>does not consume Computing Power quota</color>.
